plugins.name: core-lifecycle
plugins.description: Full development lifecycle: /dev-lifecycle orchestrator, /issue-creation, /pr-creation, /enhanced-pr-review, /ci-status, /review-pr, /issue-brief, /reproduce-then-fix, /verify-quality-gate, plus the generic agent roster and design-panel workflow.

plugins.name: guardrails
plugins.description: Safety hooks: destructive-command gate, env/secret protection, sensitive-path protection, secret detection, auto-format, test reminders, issue-creation nudge, applied-migration protection.

plugins.name: reviewer-packs
plugins.description: Specialist reviewers: migration-reviewer, red-team methodology, plus fill-in templates for RBAC, crypto, and deployment-config reviewers. red-team is adversarial exploit construction, not a scanner — it pairs with a vulnerability-scanning skill such as Anthropic's vulnhunt, which you install separately; none is bundled here.

plugins.name: fleet
plugins.description: Multi-session supervision (/supervise + session handshake). Requires the Claude Code desktop session-management MCP; degrades to no-op elsewhere.

plugins.name: starter-memory
plugins.description: Optional starter memory pack: curated generic facts about gh/git/CI/subagent workflows.
